description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acqnisitions of the Lands in D/S Division, Rambnkkana, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation deposits for land acquisitions. It includes detailed descriptions of specific lands (names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and boundary locations) being acquired, which falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes dealing with land acquisitions and property matters.
